name: 7.62x51_appalachian_m62_142gr_red_tracer

name: 7.62x54r_tsniitekhmash_7n37_182gr_bs

finding: Internal name prefix 7.82x51 is a typo for 7.62x51.

name: 9x18_tsniitekhmash_sp7_gzh_80gr

name: kf_416_barrel_nut

name: r870_211mm_sawn_off

name: cnc_warrior_m14x1lh_to_5_8x24rh_muzzle_thread_adapter
finding: Thread adapter with velocity -30, deviation 0.15 and recoil +2/+2 is heavy for a thread adapter.

name: ferro_ordnance_mc51sd_125mm_7.62x51_barrel

name: hart_m4a1_front_side_sling_swivel

name: ips_1_2x28_to_5_8x24_knurled_thread_adapter
finding: Thread adapter with bullet_velocity -200, recoil +2/+2 and deviation 0.2 is far too large for pitch-adapter hardware.

name: rat_worx_aug_5.56x45_supp_adapter
finding: Thread adapter carries bullet_velocity +30; an adapter should not add velocity.

name: roosevelt_model_700_508mm_.308_heavy_barrel

name: whtnls_m4a1_5.56x45_406mm_govt_m_barrel

name: izhevsk_akm_type2_bayonet_blade

name: ontarioknife_m11_eod_knife_blade
finding: Unreachable, but same fold: old net -3 (blade -4, grip +1), now -4 with the grip zeroed.

name: izhevsk_akm_type1_bayonet_blade
finding: Section 15 puts bayonets on handling only; notes chose h 0.8A, s 1.0A. Handling-only is defensible: front-mass damping already sits in v recoil. All four blades.

name: grip_pod_gps_02_legs_col
finding: Grip pod held as a bulky vertical grip: handling cost, small stability gain. EV -0.86 vs V -1.

name: grip_pod_gps_02_legs_ext

name: smite_industries_bipod_foregrip_extended_legs
finding: Same as GPS-02 extended: steadier and clumsier than collapsed.

outcome: not applied: the carry handle moved to mount instead

name: tt_c_optic_rail
